lines.en: label nikiinvite1:
I tap on Niki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: And, of course, I prepare myself for the worst since she is very rarely able to make any time for me given her incredibly busy schedule as a famous person or whatever.
lines.zh: 当然，我也做好了最坏的打算——毕竟她现在是个名人还是什么，日程忙得要命，几乎不可能为我挤出时间。

lines.en: In fact, even if she {i}does{/i} answer by some stretch of the imagination, I doubt she’ll be willing to accept an invite over to-
lines.zh: 事实上，就算她{i}破天荒{/i}接了电话，我也怀疑她会不会愿意接受我的邀请，过来——

lines.en: : Hey. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿。什么事？

lines.en: : Oh, you answered.
lines.zh: : 哦，你接了。

lines.en: : What? Were you starting to think I’m too good for you now or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你该不会开始觉得我现在高攀不起你了吧？

lines.en: : I wonder what would have given me that idea.
lines.zh: : 真不知道是什么让我产生了那种想法。

lines.en: : I would have given you that idea- because I {i}am{/i} too good for you now.
lines.zh: : 是我让你产生的——因为我现在{i}确实{/i}高攀不起你了。

lines.en: : This is a fun conversation.
lines.zh: : 这对话真有意思。

lines.en: : It truly is.
lines.zh: : 确实是。

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 总之，你现在在干嘛？

lines.en: : I’m working up the courage to invite you over, but your idolic presence is so commanding and intimidating that I’m having trouble finding the words.
lines.zh: : 我正在鼓起勇气邀请你过来，可你那偶像气场太有压迫感、太吓人了，我连话都说不利索。

lines.en: : Wow, are you actually going to tell me where you live after all of these years away?
lines.zh: : 哇，这么多年过去了，你终于肯告诉我你住哪儿了？

lines.en: : If I say yes, will you come over and have sex with me?
lines.zh: : 如果我说肯，你会过来和我做爱吗？

lines.en: : What, like now? Fuck off. No.
lines.zh: : 什么，就现在？滚蛋。不行。

lines.en: : I’ll come say hi, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我会过来打个招呼。

lines.en: : You’re actually able to?
lines.zh: : 你真的抽得出空？

lines.en: : I’m taking the night off, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 我今晚休假，所以可以。

lines.en: : Just text me the address and I’ll have my driver take me.
lines.zh: : 把地址发我，我让司机送我过去。

lines.en: : Oh- and before I forget, is Ami home?
lines.zh: : 哦——顺便问一句，Ami 在家吗？

lines.en: : I...think so?
lines.zh: : 我……应该在吧？

lines.en: : Even better. See you soon.
lines.zh: : 那就更好了。待会儿见。

lines.en: scene black
Welp, it looks like Niki {i}is{/i} going to come over after all.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来 Niki 最后还{i}是{/i}要来。

lines.en: As I type out my address to her, I think to myself about what it must be like to have people willing to wait on your every beck and call.
lines.zh: 我把地址打给她的时候，不禁想，有人愿意随叫随到地伺候你，到底是什么感觉。

lines.en: But, then I remember that Ami exists and realize that Niki just isn’t that special after all.
lines.zh: 但接着我想起了 Ami 的存在，意识到 Niki 其实也没那么特别。

lines.en: No amount of drivers or bodyguards can live up to the calming, yet mildly intimidating presence of a red-haired [niece].
lines.zh: 再多的司机和保镖，也比不上一个红头发 [niece] 那种让人安心、却又略带压迫感的存在。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin1
The doorbell rings shortly after I take my shoes off and I pat myself on the back for making it here in time.
lines.zh: 我刚脱完鞋门铃就响了，我暗自庆幸自己总算赶得及先到家。

lines.en: I can only imagine how Ami would have reacted if she answered the door to find her icon just...standing there.
lines.zh: 我只能想象，如果开门的是 Ami，发现她的偶像就那么……杵在那儿，她会是什么反应。

lines.en: : Stop monologuing and open the fucking door.
lines.zh: : 别在那儿内心独白了，赶紧把该死的门打开。

lines.en: : Well, that’s just plain rude.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，这可真没礼貌。

lines.en: : Sensei! Let us in!
lines.zh: : Sensei！让我们进去！

lines.en: What? Noriko is here too?
lines.zh: 什么？Noriko 也来了？

lines.en: I mean, as much as I love the idea of taking both Nakayama sisters’ virginities at once, I didn’t think that would be in the cards today.
lines.zh: 我是说，虽然我一向很乐意同时夺走中山姐妹俩的初夜，但我没想到今天会有这种机会。

lines.en: But, even with the prospect of that being slightly possible, I have now obtained all of the motivation I need to let them in.
lines.zh: 不过，哪怕只有那么一丁点可能，我现在也已经拿到了放她们进来所需的全部动力。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin2
: Hi. Your neighborhood sucks.
lines.zh: : 嗨。你这小区真烂。

lines.en: : Thanks. Why did you even need my address if Noriko was coming? She could have just shown you the way.
lines.zh: : 谢了。既然 Noriko 也来，你干嘛还要我地址？她直接带你过来不就行了。

lines.en: : I didn’t even know I was coming until a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 我也是不久前才知道自己要来的。

lines.en: : Also, I had no idea that you routinely invited my little sister over to your house.
lines.zh: : 还有，我可一点都不知道你经常把我家妹妹叫到你家来。

lines.en: : I mean...I wouldn’t call it {i}routinely{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我说……我可不会称之为“{i}经常{/i}”。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin3
: This is where Sensei made me into a woman!
lines.zh: : 就是在那儿，Sensei 把我变成了女人！

lines.en: : If you guys are gonna have sex, make sure you dig your nails into his back really hard. That's his favorite.
lines.zh: : 你们俩要是做爱的话，记得把指甲狠狠掐进他背里。他最喜欢那个。

lines.en: : Very funny.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin4
: About what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体是哪一点？

lines.en: : Why Noriko came. And why she’s carrying your bags. And why I don’t remember making her into a woman or the sensation of her nails against my skin.
lines.zh: : Noriko 为什么来。她为什么帮你提袋子。还有为什么我一点都不记得把她变成过女人，也不记得她指甲划过我皮肤的触感。

lines.en: : Maybe I drugged you? It certainly wouldn’t be the first time.
lines.zh: : 说不定是我给你下了药呢？反正这也不是第一次了。

lines.en: : Ooookay. Now {i}I’m{/i} confused.
lines.zh: : 好好好。现在换{i}我{/i}糊涂了。

lines.en: : The bags just have some stuff I brought over for Ami. Mostly old clothes and extra merchandise that I didn’t have a use for anymore.
lines.zh: : 袋子里就是些我给 Ami 带过来的东西。多半是些我穿不着的旧衣服和多余的周边。

lines.en: : And also a bunch of stuff that she bought because she wants Ami to like her.
lines.zh: : 还有一堆她因为想让 Ami 喜欢她而买的东西。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin5
: Noriko! Shut the fuck up or I’m not paying you for this!
lines.zh: : Noriko！给我闭嘴，不然这笔工钱我不付了！

lines.en: : Yes, Nee-chan. Anything you say.
lines.zh: : 是，姐姐。你说什么都行。

lines.en: : You actually bought stuff for Ami? Even I don’t buy stuff for Ami.
lines.zh: : 你还真给 Ami 买了东西？连我都没给 Ami 买过东西。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin6
: Yeah, well you’re an asshole and I’m a thoughtful and caring person.
lines.zh: : 那是，你是个混蛋，而我体贴又细心。

lines.en: : Where is she, by the way?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，她人在哪儿？

lines.en: : She’ll be here any second now. The scent of females probably set off an alarm in her brain and caused her defense mode to start.
lines.zh: : 她随时都会出现。雌性的气味大概触发了她脑子里的警报，启动了她的防御模式。

lines.en: : Sensei! Are there girls here?! You know how I feel about you inviting-
lines.zh: : Sensei！有女孩子在吗？！你知道我对你带——

lines.en: scene girlsnightin7
: Ah! Niki! My queen!
lines.zh: : 啊！Niki！我的女王！

lines.en: : My mind says attack but my heart says love!
lines.zh: : 我的理智说攻击，但我的心说爱！

lines.en: : Hi, Ami! Are you free right now?
lines.zh: : 你好呀，Ami！你现在有空吗？

lines.en: : Me?! Yes! I am always free for you! I will kill for you! Just say the word!
lines.zh: : 我？！有！我随时都为你有空！我可以为你去杀人！只要你一句话！

lines.en: : Uhh...where should I put these bags? They’re getting kinda heavy.
lines.zh: : 呃……这些袋子我该放哪儿？有点重了。

lines.en: : Wonderful. Because I was hoping that the two of us would be able to get to know each other a little better if that’s okay with you.
lines.zh: : 太好了。因为我在想，如果可以的话，我们两个能不能好好了解一下彼此。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin8
: What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : I mean...I just expected this to be a more private or personal invitation.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我本来以为这会是个更私密、更私人一点的邀请。

lines.en: : Private or-
lines.zh: : 私密还是——

lines.en: scene girlsnightin9
: Wait- did you think I came here for {i}you?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等——你该不会以为我是为{i}你{/i}来的吧？！

lines.en: : Well...considering I was the one who invited you...
lines.zh: : 呃……考虑到是我邀请的你……

lines.en: : Oh, you sweet summer child. I’m just here to talk to Ami.
lines.zh: : 噢，你个天真的孩子。我只是来跟 Ami 聊天的。

lines.en: : Why am I the sweet summer child? I’m supposed to be the protagonist.
lines.zh: : 我怎么就天真了？我才是主角吧。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin10
: Well then, Mr. Protagonist, why don’t you make yourself useful and go on a little side quest to the convenience store and get us some snacks while we have a bit of a girls’ night in?
lines.zh: : 那么，主角先生，你不如发挥点用处，接个支线任务去趟便利店，给我们买点零食，好让我们办一场小小的闺蜜之夜？

lines.en: : A...girls’ night with...Niki?
lines.zh: : 闺蜜之夜……和 Niki？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin11
: And Noriko! I’m here too!
lines.zh: : 还有 Noriko！我也在呢！

lines.en: : Do you like french fries, Ami? We stopped at a fast food place before coming over.
lines.zh: : Ami，你喜欢薯条吗？我们过来前在快餐店停了一下。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin12
: I love you! I mean- I {i}love{/i} french fries!
lines.zh: : 我{i}爱{/i}你！我是说——我爱薯条！

lines.en: : But surely your love for me outweighs the chance to hang out with Niki and eat fast-
lines.zh: : 可你对我的爱，总该比跟 Niki 一起玩、吃快——

lines.en: scene girlsnightin1
: This way to the living room!
lines.zh: : 客厅这边请！

lines.en: : If I had known you were coming, I would have cleaned up first!
lines.zh: : 我要是早知道你要来，肯定会先打扫一下的！

lines.en: : Didn’t you clean this morning?
lines.zh: : 你今天早上不是打扫过了吗？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin13
: I’m sorry, were you not listening when I asked you to run along and leave us alone?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我刚才让你滚出去别烦我们，你是没听见吗？

lines.en: : I was listening. I just assumed it was a joke on account of {i}this being my house.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我听见了。我只是以为那是个玩笑，毕竟{i}这是我家{/i}。

lines.en: : I vote that Sensei stays!
lines.zh: : 我投 Sensei 留下！

lines.en: : See? Noriko and Ami both want me to stay.
lines.zh: : 瞧？Noriko 和 Ami 都想让我留下。

lines.en: : Funny. I don’t remember Ami saying anything like that.
lines.zh: : 真好笑。我可不记得 Ami 说过类似的话。

lines.en: : It’s Ami. She doesn’t have to say it. It’s just always true. Right, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那是 Ami。她不用说出来。反正永远都是真的。对吧，Ami？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin14
: Well, would you look at that?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你瞧瞧？

lines.en: : Of all the times to betray me...
lines.zh: : 偏偏挑这个时候背叛我……

lines.en: : I tried, Sensei. I really did.
lines.zh: : 我努力了，Sensei。我真的努力了。

lines.en: : Okay, I’ll go. But I’m taking Noriko with me.
lines.zh: : 行，我走。但我要把 Noriko 带上。

lines.en: : No, you’re not. Noriko’s on the clock.
lines.zh: : 不行。Noriko 在上班。

lines.en: : She’s right. I am but a slave to the machine that is the idol industry right now.
lines.zh: : 她说得对。我现在不过是被称作偶像产业的那台机器的奴隶罢了。

lines.en: : I won’t forget this, Niki.
lines.zh: : 我不会忘了这事的，Niki。

lines.en: : Ooooh, so you won’t forget {i}this{/i}, but you’ll forget the five years we dated and how you ruined my life. I’m glad to understand your priorities a little better now.
lines.zh: : 噢，所以你不会忘了{i}这{/i}事，却会忘了我们谈了五年恋爱、还有你是怎么毁了我人生的。我很高兴能更清楚地了解你的优先级。

lines.en: : Hey, in a roundabout way, if it wasn’t for me-
lines.zh: : 嘿，绕个弯说，如果不是因为我——

lines.en: : If you are about to take credit for all of the hard work I’ve invested into reforming myself, I’m just going to steal Ami and never give her back.
lines.zh: : 如果你接下来要把我为了改造自己所付出的全部努力都算成你的功劳，那我就直接把 Ami 偷走，永远不还给你。

lines.en: : But then who will do the dishes?
lines.zh: : 那谁来洗碗？

lines.en: : Oh! Me! Me! Noriko will do them!
lines.zh: : 哦！我！我！Noriko 来洗！

lines.en: : Goodbye, [nikitemp]. Walk slowly, because if you’re back in any less than two hours, I’m not undoing the chain lock.
lines.zh: : 再见，[nikitemp]。走慢点，因为只要你两小时之内回来，我就不会解开防盗链。

lines.en: : But the convenience store is only a few minutes-
lines.zh: : 可便利店只有几分钟路——

lines.en: : One more word out of you and it’ll be {i}three{/i} hours.
lines.zh: : 你再多说一个字，就是{i}三个{/i}小时。

lines.en: scene black
You know...
lines.zh: 你知道吗……

lines.en: This is really not how I planned on tonight going.
lines.zh: 今晚真不是我计划中的样子。

lines.en: The next time I invite Niki over, I should make her clarify that she will be spending her time with {i}me{/i} rather than trying to poach my [niece].
lines.zh: 下次再叫 Niki 过来，{i}我{/i}得先让她说清楚，她是来陪我的，而不是来挖走我的 [niece] 的。

lines.en: I begrudgingly exit the house- but as I glance back inside to see if Ami is maybe having second thoughts about letting me leave, I see nothing.
lines.zh: 我磨磨蹭蹭地出了门——可我回头往屋里瞥了一眼，想看看 Ami 会不会后悔放我走，结果什么也没看到。

lines.en: Just an empty space where my [niece] once stood, only to be stolen away by a girl with cotton candy hair.
lines.zh: 只剩下一片原本站着我的 [niece] 的空地，而她已经被一个顶着棉花糖色头发的姑娘抢走了。

lines.en: First my shirt...now this?
lines.zh: 先是我的衬衫……现在又是这个？

lines.en: Ex-girlfriends really are terrifying...
lines.zh: 前女友真是可怕……

lines.en: scene girlsnightin15
: Why do you look so nervous?
lines.zh: : 你看起来怎么这么紧张？

lines.en: : Um...because you’re Niki Nakayama and I’m just some random girl who can’t even get a high score on any of your songs in the karaoke booth?
lines.zh: : 呃……因为你是中山 Niki，而我只是个普通的女孩子，连你哪首歌都拿不到高分？

lines.en: : Okay, so...that might be who I {i}normally{/i} am. But right now, you can look at me as a...family friend.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……{i}平时{/i}我大概确实是那样。但现在，你可以把我看作一个……家里的朋友。

lines.en: : That’s...the part that’s hard for me to do, though.
lines.zh: : 可……难的就是这一点啊。

lines.en: : Even if you did date my [uncle] in the past, I don’t think I was really old enough to remember it.
lines.zh: : 就算你过去和我 [uncle] 谈过恋爱，我觉得那时候我也没大到能记事。

lines.en: : And I wouldn’t expect you to. But since {i}I{/i} remember you, that’s really all that matters.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}也没指望你记得。但既然我还记得你，那才是真正要紧的。

lines.en: : Nee-chan owes you a big debt of gratitude for managing to keep Sensei on his feet after all these years.
lines.zh: : 姐姐我欠你一个大人情，毕竟这些年是你撑着 Sensei 没让他倒下。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin16
: I don’t give two shits about whether he’s on his feet or not. I just want to make sure that Ami is doing okay since I...feel bad that {i}he{/i} had to be her guardian.
lines.zh: : 他是站着还是趴着，我{i}他{/i}妈一点都不在乎。我只是想确认 Ami 过得还好，因为我……对他不得不当她的监护人这件事感到愧疚。

lines.en: : I’m doing great. I’ve actually never been happier.
lines.zh: : 我过得很好。事实上，我从没这么幸福过。

lines.en: : It’s true that things were really bad for a while, but we were there for each other when we had to be.
lines.zh: : 确实有过一段很艰难的日子，但在必须撑住的时候，我们一直陪在彼此身边。

lines.en: : And even if Sensei isn’t the best guardian and I had to get a job because he wouldn’t buy me things, I can tell he loves me.
lines.zh: : 就算 Sensei 不是最好的监护人，就算他不肯给我买东西、害得我不得不去打工，我也能看出来他爱我。

lines.en: : In fact, I can tell he loves me even more than {i}he{/i} thinks he loves me.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我看得出来，{i}他{/i}爱我的程度，比他自己以为的还要深。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin17
: That’s kind of just how it is with that guy. Never understood why, but it’s like he’s always kept how he really feels locked up so tightly that it looks more like he feels nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 那个人就是这种性子。我一直不懂为什么，但他好像总是把自己真正的感受锁得死死的，紧到看起来更像是什么感觉都没有。

lines.en: : Is that why you’ve always bossed him around?
lines.zh: : 所以你才总是对他呼来喝去？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin18
: I never {i}bossed him around.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我从来没有{i}对他呼来喝去{/i}。

lines.en: : Nee-chan, you are {i}still{/i} bossing him around. You just kicked him out of his own house so we could talk to Ami.
lines.zh: : 姐姐，你{i}现在就{/i}在对他呼来喝去。你刚把他从自己家里赶出去，就为了我们能跟 Ami 说话。

lines.en: : There’s a difference between bossing him around and having to make decisions for him! I’m sure Ami knows, but sometimes you {i}have{/i} to push him in a certain direction or he'll just get lost.
lines.zh: : 呼来喝去和替他拿主意是两码事！我相信 Ami 懂，但有时候你{i}不推他一把{/i}，他就只会迷失方向。

lines.en: : And today...that direction was the convenience store.
lines.zh: : 而今天……那个方向是便利店。

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe {i}that{/i} was bossy.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许{i}那个{/i}是有点呼来喝去了。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin19
: But I did it to get closer to Ami, so it was all worth it.
lines.zh: : 但我这么做是为了和 Ami 拉近关系，所以一切都值得。

lines.en: : I don’t understand, though...why do you want to get closer to me? It can’t just be because you think Sensei is a bad guardian or that...you want to thank me.
lines.zh: : 可我就不懂了……你为什么想和我拉近关系？总不能只是因为你觉得 Sensei 是个糟糕的监护人，或者……你想谢谢我。

lines.en: : I just did what any other girl in my position would do because...Sensei’s the only family I have now.
lines.zh: : 我只是做了任何一个处在我这个位置的女孩都会做的事，因为……Sensei 是我现在唯一的家人了。

lines.en: : But he doesn’t have to be.
lines.zh: : 但他不必是你唯一的家人。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin20
: Are you trying to marry him?!
lines.zh: : 你该不会是想嫁给他吧？！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……

lines.en: : What? No. I’m not even trying to date him.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。我连想跟他交往都不是。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to say that I wouldn’t mind if...there was suddenly a third Nakayama sister or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，如果……突然多出第三个中山家的姐妹什么的，我不会介意。

lines.en: : Even if we’re not as close to [nikitemp] as we used to be, he’s still an important part of our lives that’s never going to go away. And Ami deserves a lot more than just him.
lines.zh: : 就算我们和 [nikitemp] 不像从前那么亲近了，他也依然是我们生命中永远不会消失的重要一部分。而 Ami 值得拥有的远不止他一个人。

lines.en: : Why do you keep calling him [nikitemp]?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直叫他 [nikitemp]？

lines.en: : I was wondering that, too.
lines.zh: : 我也一直想问这个。

lines.en: : Unimportant.
lines.zh: : 不重要。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin21
: I just want to do my part for both an unofficial family member {i}and{/i} one of my biggest fans in letting her know that I’ll always be here for her.
lines.zh: : 我只是想为一位非正式的家人、{i}也是{/i}我最铁杆的粉丝之一尽一份力，让她知道我永远都会在她身边。

lines.en: : Even when her [uncle] manages to fuck things up all over again, which he definitely will.
lines.zh: : 哪怕她 [uncle] 又把事情搞砸一遍——而他绝对会的。

lines.en: : I’ll be here, too.
lines.zh: : 我也会在的。

lines.en: : Obviously, that’s probably not as cool as my sister saying it, but you really are like family to us.
lines.zh: : 显然，这话由我姐姐说出来大概没那么酷，但你对我们来说真的就像家人一样。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what to say...
lines.zh: : 我真不知道该说什么……

lines.en: : This is all really sudden and it feels kinda like a dream.
lines.zh: : 这一切都太突然了，感觉有点像在做梦。

lines.en: : Just a...convenient side effect of us growing up in the house next door to your [uncle].
lines.zh: : 就当是……我们在你 [uncle] 隔壁长大带来的一个顺带的副作用吧。

lines.en: : I always wanted to do something like this if we ever wound up walking into your life again, so consider it my way of making amends for not being there earlier...when I wanted to be.
lines.zh: : 如果有一天我们真能重新走进你的人生，我一直都想做这样的事——所以，就当作是我为当初没能陪在你身边、明明那时我是想陪的……所做的一点补偿吧。

lines.en: : Are you sure you’re not trying to marry him?
lines.zh: : 你确定你不是想嫁给他？

lines.en: scene girlsnightin22
: Uh...yeah.
lines.zh: : 呃……确定。

lines.en: : Because if you do, I won’t let you use your big sister powers to get rid of me.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你要嫁，我可不会让你用姐姐的特权把我甩掉。

lines.en: : Marrying Sensei includes promising to look after me for the rest of my life, as I have sworn to be there for him whether he wants me to or not.
lines.zh: : 嫁给 Sensei，就等于承诺这辈子都要照顾我，而我早已发过誓，不管他愿不愿意都要陪在他身边。

lines.en: : That’s...fine?
lines.zh: : 那……也行？

lines.en: : Don’t get me wrong, I’d still prefer that you {i}don’t{/i} marry Sensei. But if there is going to be anyone I would make an exception for, it’s you.
lines.zh: : 别误会，我还是更希望你{i}别{/i}嫁给 Sensei。但如果非要有例外的话，那个人就是你。

lines.en: : As long as you also agree to the thing I said, I mean.
lines.zh: : 前提是你也同意我刚才说的那件事，我是说。

lines.en: : What do you think? She seems like she’ll be even higher maintenance as a sister than I am and I {i}still{/i} steal your clothes without telling you sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你怎么看？她看起来当妹妹会比我还难伺候，而我有时候{i}还会{/i}不打招呼就偷你衣服穿。

lines.en: : I don’t care how “high maintenance” she is. I just want her to have somebody else to rely on.
lines.zh: : 我才不管她有多“难伺候”。我只是希望她能有别的人可以依靠。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin23
: Well...I’m not sure {i}how{/i} I’m supposed to rely on you when I’m already happy with how things are...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我都已经对现状这么满意了，真不知道该{i}怎么{/i}去依靠你……

lines.en: : But I...would like to see you more, if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 但……如果可以的话，我希望能多见见你。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to look at you as family...but I know that you really do care about my [uncle] and...that I can’t ignore your past with each other no matter how much I want to.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己能不能真的把你们当家人看……但我知道，你是真的在乎我 [uncle]，而且……不管我多想忽视，你们之间的过去我都无法否认。

lines.en: : Why would you want-
lines.zh: : 你为什么会想——

lines.en: scene girlsnightin24
: At the end of the day...I’m just happy to have you two on my side.
lines.zh: : 说到底……我很高兴你们两个能站在我这边。

lines.en: : Your side as opposed to what?
lines.zh: : 你这边？相对于哪一边？

lines.en: : Any side that wants to get rid of me.
lines.zh: : 任何想把我赶走的那一边。

lines.en: : Sensei is my entire life- and neither of you think that’s a problem.
lines.zh: : Sensei 就是我的全部——而你们两个都不觉得这有什么问题。

lines.en: : I mean...he’s not your {i}entire{/i} life, is he?
lines.zh: : 我是说……他不至于就是你的{i}全部{/i}吧？

lines.en: : He is. And if either of you two hurt him, I will be very, {i}very{/i} unkind to you.
lines.zh: : 他就是。如果你们两个里有谁伤了他，我会对你们{i}非常{/i}、非常不客气。

lines.en: : If you are okay with that...then I’m okay with letting you two in.
lines.zh: : 如果你们能接受这一点……那我就愿意让你们两个走进来。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin25
: Any objections, Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko，有意见吗？

lines.en: : To a life of nothing but pleasing Sensei? Do you even have to ask?
lines.zh: : 一辈子只为了取悦 Sensei 而活？这还用问吗？

lines.en: : I hate that I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我恨自己居然不讨厌这个答案。

lines.en: : Besides, I doubt it’s even possible to hurt him at this point.
lines.zh: : 再说，我怀疑到了这个地步，已经没什么能伤到他了。

lines.en: : If anything {i}does{/i} hurt him, he’ll just rationalize it in whatever twisted way his weirdo brain wants to come up with and come out totally fine within a matter of days.
lines.zh: : 就算{i}真{/i}有什么伤到他，他那颗怪胎脑袋也会用某种扭曲的方式把它合理化，几天之内就彻底没事了。

lines.en: scene girlsnightin26
: It’s settled, then!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了！

lines.en: : From now on, the two of you can come over as much as you like as long as you don’t touch my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : 从今往后，你们两个想来就来，只要别碰我 [uncle]！

lines.en: : A step in the right direction! Hooray!
lines.zh: : 朝着正确的方向迈出了一步！万岁！

lines.en: : I’m happy to hear that, Ami.
lines.zh: : 听你这么说我很高兴，Ami。

lines.en: : I really hope that the two of us can grow closer.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望我们两个能走得更近。

lines.en: scene black
scene girlsnightin27
: Sensei! I have sisters now!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我现在有姐妹了！

lines.en: : Welcome home, Onii-chan! Wanna get in the bath together?
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，哥哥！要一起泡澡吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s been two hours yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得还没到两小时吧。

lines.en: : And yet the chainlock remains...unchained.
lines.zh: : 可防盗链……依然是没挂上的状态。

lines.en: : It has been brought to my attention that I may have been {i}slightly{/i} too bossy to you earlier- and for that, I apologize.
lines.zh: : 我意识到了，我刚才可能对你{i}稍微{/i}有点太呼来喝去了——为此我向你道歉。

lines.en: : I will now allow you to continue using your house, but not before retreating to Ami’s bedroom and having her model all of the outfits I bought for her.
lines.zh: : 现在，我允许你继续使用你的房子，但前提是我要先撤退到 Ami 的卧室，让她把我给她买的衣服全试一遍。

lines.en: : Can I come, at least?
lines.zh: : 我至少能跟着去吧？

lines.en: : No. But you can put on a pot of coffee for us, if you’d be so kind.
lines.zh: : 不行。不过你可以替我们煮一壶咖啡，如果你愿意的话。

lines.en: : Niki bought me clothes! I’m going to be pretty!
lines.zh: : Niki 给我买了衣服！我要变漂亮了！

lines.en: : You {i}are{/i} pretty, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你{i}已经{/i}很漂亮了，Ami。

lines.en: : Not pretty enough!
lines.zh: : 还不够漂亮！

lines.en: scene girlsnightin28
: Come on, Ami! Let’s get those clothes off!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Ami！把那些衣服脱掉！

lines.en: : Yes, Niki! Anything for you!
lines.zh: : 好的，Niki！为了你我什么都做！

lines.en: : NORIKO! BAGS!
lines.zh: : NORIKO！袋子！

lines.en: : I think you’re being summoned.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你在被召唤。

lines.en: : Yes. But, before I go, I would like to remind you that sometimes, fantasies don’t do the job and that you have at least one picture of my boobs in your phone to use however you want.
lines.zh: : 是的。不过在我走之前，我想提醒你，幻想有时候是顶不上用的，而你手机里至少有一张我胸部的照片，你想怎么用都行。

lines.en: : I...certainly do. But why are you telling me this now?
lines.zh: : 我……确实有。可你为什么现在跟我说这个？

lines.en: : So that you don’t think of what’s happening in Ami’s room and that you think of me instead!
lines.zh: : 好让你别去想 Ami 房间里正在发生的事，而是想着我！

lines.en: : I love you, Onii-chan! Forever and ever!
lines.zh: : 我爱你，哥哥！永远永远！

lines.en: : NORIKO! GET THE FUCKING BAGS!
lines.zh: : NORIKO！去拿那该死的袋子！

lines.en: scene black
: Coming, Nee-chan!
lines.zh: : 来了，姐姐！

lines.en: I think it might be time for me to move out.
lines.zh: 我想，我大概该搬出去了。
